sagas.name: East Blue Saga
sagas.japaneseName: 東の海（イーストブルー）編
sagas.description: Luffy sets sail into the East Blue to gather his first crewmates — Zoro, Nami, Usopp, and Sanji — and earn his first pirate bounty on the way to the Grand Line.

sagas.name: Arabasta Saga
sagas.description: The Straw Hats enter the Grand Line with Princess Vivi of Arabasta to foil the sinister plot of Warlord Crocodile and Baroque Works.

sagas.name: Sky Island Saga
sagas.description: Riding the Knock Up Stream into the clouds, the crew discovers Skypiea and battles the thunder god Enel atop the Upper Yard.

sagas.name: Water 7 Saga
sagas.description: Betrayal, heartbreak, and government espionage collide in the City of Water, forcing the Straw Hats to declare war on the World Government at Enies Lobby.

sagas.name: Thriller Bark Saga
sagas.description: Trapped in the Florian Triangle, the crew meets the skeleton musician Brook and battles the shadow-stealing Warlord Gecko Moria.

sagas.name: Summit War Saga
sagas.description: Separated across the world, Luffy infiltrates Impel Down and rushes to Marineford to rescue his brother Portgas D. Ace in the war that reshaped the world.

sagas.name: Fish-Man Island Saga
sagas.description: Reuniting after two years of intense training, the Straw Hats descend 10,000 meters beneath the sea to Fish-Man Island.

sagas.name: Dressrosa Saga
sagas.description: Forming a pirate alliance with Trafalgar Law, Luffy challenges Donquixote Doflamingo to liberate the puppet kingdom of Dressrosa.

sagas.name: Whole Cake Island Saga
sagas.japaneseName: ホールケーキアイランド編
sagas.description: Luffy infiltrates Emperor Big Mom's sweet archipelago territory to rescue Sanji from an arranged political wedding.

sagas.name: Wano Country Saga
sagas.description: In the secluded samurai nation of Wano, the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance launches an epic raid on Onigashima to overthrow Emperors Kaido and Big Mom.

sagas.name: Final Saga
sagas.description: The Straw Hats arrive at the futuristic island of Egghead and onward to Elbaf, meeting Dr. Vegapunk and unveiling ancient world-shattering secrets.

volumes.title: Romance Dawn
volumes.summary: As a boy, Monkey D. Luffy dreams of becoming the King of the Pirates. Inspired by Red-Haired Shanks, Luffy sets out in a small dinghy to gather a crew.

volumes.title: Versus!! Buggy's Pirate Crew
volumes.summary: Luffy and his first mate, swordsman Roronoa Zoro, meet the crafty thief Nami and battle Buggy the Clown and his circus pirate crew.

volumes.title: Don't Get Fooled Again
volumes.summary: The Straw Hats arrive at Syrup Village and join the habitual liar Usopp to protect the wealthy heiress Kaya from her traitorous butler, Captain Kuro.

volumes.title: The Crescent Moon
volumes.summary: Usopp stands his ground against the Black Cat Pirates. Impressed by his bravery, Luffy invites Usopp to join the crew, gaining their beloved ship, the Going Merry.

volumes.title: For Whom the Bell Tolls
volumes.summary: Seeking a cook, the Straw Hats visit the floating ocean restaurant Baratie, where they meet Sanji and witness the terrifying power of Dracule Mihawk.

volumes.title: The Oath
volumes.summary: Zoro duels Mihawk and swears never to lose again. Meanwhile, Don Krieg attempts to seize the Baratie by force, leading to a fiery showdown with Luffy.

volumes.title: The Crap-Geezer
volumes.summary: Sanji recalls his past with Chef Zeff and the shared dream of the All Blue. Luffy dismantles Krieg's armor, and Sanji officially enlists as the crew's chef.

volumes.title: I Won't Die
volumes.summary: The crew tracks Nami to Cocoyasi Village, uncovering her tragic childhood under the ruthless Fish-Man pirate Arlong.

volumes.title: Tears
volumes.summary: Nami breaks down in tears and asks Luffy for help. Placing his straw hat on her head, Luffy leads his crew into Arlong Park for retribution.

volumes.title: OK, Let's STAND UP!
volumes.summary: Luffy destroys Arlong Park with Gomu Gomu no Battle Axe, freeing Nami from her bondage and declaring her his navigator.

volumes.title: The Meanest Man in the East
volumes.summary: With a 30,000,000 Berry bounty on his head, Luffy visits Loguetown — the city of the beginning and the end where Pirate King Gold Roger was executed.

volumes.title: The Legend Begins
volumes.summary: Narrowly escaping execution atop the scaffold, the Straw Hats climb Reverse Mountain and enter the legendary Grand Line.

volumes.title: It's All Right!
volumes.summary: The Straw Hats encounter the enigmatic Baroque Works at Whiskey Peak.

volumes.title: Instinct
volumes.summary: Prehistoric giants Dorry and Brogy battle in an eternal duel on Little Garden.

volumes.title: Straight Ahead!!!
volumes.summary: Seeking a doctor for a sick Nami, the crew climbs the frozen Drum Rockies.

volumes.title: Carrying on His Will
volumes.summary: Tony Tony Chopper reveals his tragic past and joins as the crew's doctor.
